title: Expense Agent: Project Expenses (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to Expense Agent and project tasks in web app
Administrator visibility controls for projects and tasks
Licensing and role requirements for posting
Submitting expense report with project assignment in web app
Project tracking setup and expense user resource linkage
Manual project assignment fallback in Business Central

features.name: Project and task visibility in Expense Agent web app
features.description: Administrator can enable or disable visibility of projects and tasks in the web app. By default they are not visible, but can be enabled with control over exposure level to submitters.
caveats: By default projects and tasks are hidden

features.name: Submitter project assignment capability
features.description: Expense submitters can assign expenses to projects and project tasks in the web app during expense report submission. Assignment is done in the categorization tab of the expense report.
caveats: Submitter cannot post the expense or create project ledger entries
Requires controller or accountant with Easy Central license to post

features.name: Project tracking configuration in Expense Agent setup
features.description: Administrators configure project tracking through the Expense Agent configuration wizard. Options include activating project tracking and setting project visibility to all projects or assigned projects only.
caveats: Visibility can be limited to assigned projects only

features.name: Expense user to resource linkage
features.description: Expense users are linked to employees and resources to establish connection for project tracking. The linkage is configured in the expense user card.
caveats: Requires proper employee and resource setup
Link is established through expense user card

features.name: Manual project assignment fallback in Business Central
features.description: If a submitter does not know the specific project, the controller can manually add the project assignment directly in Business Central when reviewing and posting the expense.
caveats: Only available after submission to web app
